channel.title: Threat Pulse — CISA KEV additions
channel.description: Source-traceable CISA catalog additions; not environment-specific findings.

item.title: CVE-2026-132224 — Optimizely / Web Experimentation
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-11-24. Optimizely Web Experimentation External Control of Critical State Data Vulnerability. Optimizely Web Experimentation contains an external control of critical state data vulnerability in its account signup flow that could allow an attacker to impersonate existing customer users and modify Project JavaScript. Successful exploitation can result in attacker-controlled JavaScript being distributed through Optimizely-hosted assets and executed in browsers visiting affected customer websites. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-132165 — Drupal / Core
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-11-24. Drupal Core Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. Drupal Core contains a not failing securely vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to take over an existing site or execute arbitrary code via the Drupal installer. Under specific conditions, the attacker can use install.php to attempt to reinstall Drupal on the site. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-131914 — Idunno / AntiCsrf
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-11-24. Idunno AntiCsrf Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability. Idunno AntiCsrf contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via object injection. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-134624 — N-able / MailAssure
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-11-23. N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability. N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the LDAP synchronization connection check that allows an authenticated API user to connect to arbitrary internal hosts and ports, determine which are reachable, and send crafted data to internal services. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-133968 — Project MONAI / MONAI Label
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-11-23. Project MONAI MONAI Label Path Traversal Vulnerability. Project MONAI MONAI Label contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to write arbitrary files outside the intended datastore directory, potentially resulting in remote code execution. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-76466 — Cisco / Expressway Series
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-11-20. Cisco Expressway Series Use of Hard-coded Credentials Vulnerability. Cisco Expressway Series contains a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker with persistent cookies and network access to execute commands as root on a clustered device via the database service. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-129448 — Apache / Roller
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-11-20. Apache Roller Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability. Apache Roller contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the XML-RPC endpoint, which accepts and deserializes vendor extension types before authentication. This CVE covers the same underlying vulnerability as CVE-2026-82384 but applies to a broader range of affected versions. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-123890 — Broadcom / VMware vCenter
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-11-20. VMWare vCenter Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability. Broadcom VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access to vCenter to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2025-42884 — SAP / NetWeaver
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-11-20. SAP NetWeaver Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic Vulnerability. SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal contains an improper neutralization of special elements in data query logic vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to disclose or modify server information via injected JNDI environment properties or a URL used during JNDI lookup operations. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-90817 — Vanderbilt University / Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap)
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-11-18. Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) Code Injection Vulnerability. Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on the server. An attacker could exploit this via crafted HTTP requests that access an unintended controller route from a public survey context and supply a crafted file-path or stream parameter during data import processing. Exploitation requires knowledge of a valid public survey hash. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-90436 — Apache / Axis
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-11-18. Apache Axis Unsafe Reflection Vulnerability. Apache Axis contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via a crafted SOAP fault message that causes Axis to load and instantiate an attacker-specified class when a suitable class is available on the application classpath. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-40217 — BerriAI / LiteLLM
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-11-18. BerriAI LiteLLM Unprotected Alternate Channel Vulnerability. BerriAI LiteLLM contains an unprotected alternate channel vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via bytecode rewriting at the /guardrails/test_custom_code URI. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2024-10441 — Synology / DiskStation Manager (DSM)
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-11-18. Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output Vulnerability. Synology DSM contains an improper encoding or escaping of output vulnerability in the system plugin daemon in Synology BeeStation OS (BSM) that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via unspecified vectors. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-115731 — Perforce / Puppet Enterprise
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-11-17. Perforce Puppet Enterprise Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability. Perforce Puppet Enterprise contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in Puppet’s report-processing code that allows a client with any CA-signed agent certificate to execute arbitrary code on the Puppet Server as the service user by submitting a report containing a crafted rich-data type through a PUT request. If the certificate authority automatically signs requests without strong verification, an unauthenticated network attacker can obtain a valid certificate and exploit the vulnerability. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-123039 — Check Point / Multiple Products
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-11-13. Check Point Multiple Products Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource Vulnerability. Check Point Firewall, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Scalable Platforms, Security Gateway, and Security Management Server contain an incorrect permissions assignment for critical resources vulnerability when the Gaia OS DynamicCLI daemon runs as root and listens on a world-writable local socket without authenticating connecting processes. An authenticated local user can send a command to the socket and have it executed as root. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-114713 — UnrealIRCd / UnrealIRCd
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-11-13. UnrealIRCd Improper Neutralization of Delimiters Vulnerability. UnrealIRCd UnrealIRCd contains an improper neutralization of delimiters vulnerability that allows any user on a network with two or more linked servers to inject server-to-server commands that are executed with server authority. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-20320 — Cisco / BroadWorks
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-11-10. Cisco BroadWorks Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference Vulnerability. Cisco BroadWorks contains an improper restriction of XML external entity reference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to read sensitive configuration information on an affected system. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-125350 — Google / Chromium
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-11-10. Google Chromium Use-After-Free Vulnerability. Google Chromium contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XML component that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a specially crafted webpage. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-124194 — Microsoft / Office
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-11-10. Microsoft Office Outlook Missing User Interaction for Potentially Unsafe Action Vulnerability. Microsoft Office Outlook contains a missing user interaction for potentially unsafe action vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-116606 — Barracuda Networks / Barracuda Email Security Gateway (ESG)
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-11-10. Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability. Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to invoke a configuration-import function and restore a crafted, compatible backup archive, resulting in unauthorized modification of the appliance’s global configuration. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-111560. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-111793 — Openwave Messaging Limited / Webtop Media Transcoder
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-11-10. Openwave Messaging Limited Webtop Media Transcoder Incorrect Resource Transfer Between Spheres Vulnerability. Openwave Messaging Limited Webtop Media Transcoder contains an incorrect resource transfer between spheres vulnerability that may allow an authenticated user to process and convert unintended document types if bypassing the Webmail experience. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-111560 — Barracuda Networks / Multiple Products
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-11-10. Barracuda Networks Multiple Products OS Command Injection Vulnerability. Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG), Load Balancer, Application Delivery Controller (ADC), Message Archiver (BMA), WAF Control Center (WCC), Web Application Firewall (WAF), and Web Security Gateway (WSG) contain an OS command injection vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow an authenticated administrator to inject OS commands that execute with root privileges when the crafted timezone value is subsequently processed. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-116606 Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-123218 — IBM / Aspera Faspex
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-11-09. IBM Aspera Faspex Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability. IBM Aspera Faspex contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to craft a specific message to bypass authorization, causing privilege escalations. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-123158 — OpenBSD / OpenSSH
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-11-09. OpenBSD OpenSSH Unexpected Status Code or Return Value Vulnerability. OpenBSD OpenSSH on Linux contains an unexpected status code or return value vulnerability that could allow for authentication bypass. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-116779 — SignalWire / FreeSwitch
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-11-09. SignalWire FreeSwitch Code Injection Vulnerability. SignalWire FreeSwitch contains a code injection vulnerability that permits configuration and credential disclosure, arbitrary call control, and command execution. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-102895 — GPUStack / GPUStack
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-11-09. GPUStack Improper Authentication Vulnerability. GPUStack contains an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow unauthenticated administrative access, including user and model changes, persistent administrator API-key creation, disclosure of worker and cloud-provider secrets, and code execution through POST /v2/inference-backends/from-yaml. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-19868 — SonicWall / SonicOS SSLVPN
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-11-06. SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN Use of Single-factor Authentication Vulnerability. SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN contains a use of single-factor authentication vulnerability that may allow a user with valid credentials for an alternate authentication method to bypass SAML authentication controls. Successful exploitation may also bypass SAML-enforced multi-factor authentication (MFA). Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2024-27834 — Apple / Multiple Products
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-11-04. Apple Multiple Products Improper Authentication Vulnerability. Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Safari, tvOS and watchOS 10.5 contain an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow an attacker with arbitrary read and write capability to bypass pointer authentication. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-119977 — WordPress / WordPress Core
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-11-03. WordPress WordPress Core Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) Race Condition Vulnerability. WordPress WordPress Core contains a time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute code on the server during the upgrade window. This is due to predictable, web-accessible staging paths used during full-package core upgrades. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-118527 — Ivanti / Connect Secure
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-30. Ivanti Connect Secure Generation of Predictable Numbers or Identifiers Vulnerability. Ivanti Connect Secure contains a generation of predictable numbers or identifiers vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to upload files with attacker-controlled content to a known location on disk. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-111357. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.
